label: Contrapunctus 8
title: The Art of Fugue, Contrapunctus 8, triple fugue in three voices

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 10–11) in part, with the alto's line in the soprano, the bass's line in the alto, at the same pitch level. Soprano: a figure from subject 2 (2 times), in a sequence rising by a third every bar. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 and a figure from subject 2. Bass: a figure from subject 2 (3 times).
sections.leads: From D minor to A minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in A minor (Alto); Subject in E minor (Bass)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from subject 2, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Alto: a figure from subject 2 (2 times) and a figure from subject 3 and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Bass: a figure from subject 2 (5 times), in a sequence falling by a third every bar.
sections.leads: From E minor to D minor

Bass: a figure from subject 2 (2 times) and a figure from subject 2, inverted (2 times) and a figure from subject 3 and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.

Episode 8
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from subject 2 (3 times) and a figure from subject 2, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from subject 2 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. sections.leads: Between two statements in D minor

sections.label: Link
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 7 (bars 77–79) in part, in the same voices, at the same pitch. Soprano: a figure from subject 2. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint. Returns in Episode 9 (bars 103–105). Returns in Episode 12 (bars 135–147).

sections.label: Episode 9
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bars 98–99) in part, with alto and bass exchanged, transposed. Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from subject 2.
sections.leads: Between two statements in D minor

sections.label: Episode 10
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 7 (bars 77–79) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, the alto's line in the bass, the bass's line in the soprano, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: a figure from subject 2 (8 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from subject 2 (5 times) and a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Bass: a figure from subject 2 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a fourth every half bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in D minor; perfect cadence in A minor at bar 124

sections.label: Together: Subject in D minor (Alto); Subject in D minor, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 11
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from subject 2 (2 times), in a sequence rising by a third every bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a third every bar.
sections.leads: From D minor to A minor

sections.label: Combination: Subject in A minor (Bass); Subject 2 (Alto)
Episode 12
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bars 98–99) in part, in the same voices, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: a figure from subject 2 (3 times) and a figure from subject 3, inverted and a figure from subject 2, inverted. Alto: a figure from subject 2, inverted (4 times) and a figure from subject 2 (2 times) and the opening of subject 2, in a sequence rising by a sixth every bar. Bass: a figure from subject 2, inverted (4 times) and a figure from subject 2 (3 times) and a figure from subject 3 and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a fourth every bar.
sections.leads: From A minor to F major; perfect cadence in C major at bar 140
